purpose: Make figures and tables from the completed repair quality and cost analysis.
view: clean reference F1 and repair side effects
primary_f1_cohort: 40 cases with a nonempty clean reference
empty_reference_cohort: 10 domain_range cases with an empty clean reference
reporting_rules: Use the stored quality cost and RQ2 summaries. Do not rerun a model, validator, grounding assessor, or reasoner.
The main F1 results use only cases whose initial reference_size is greater than 0. The 10 domain_range cases with an empty clean reference do not appear in the main F1 figures or the main F1 table.
Clean reference F1 compares the current graph to the controlled clean graph as sets. It is not human source faithfulness. It is not Text2KGBench F1.
The scatter of F1 change against collateral edits is descriptive. It does not define a Pareto front.
Round means at later rounds include only the cases still running. They are not a follow up of the same cases at every round.
Recorded duration is Ollama total_duration_ns converted to seconds. It is not wall clock time. It is not money.
Bootstrap intervals describe resampling of these controlled cases. They are not population confidence intervals.
An output failure is a trajectory outcome. A failed round has no graph. F1 is omitted for that round. It is not stored as 0.
For cases with an empty clean reference, the quality result is the number of extra triples, not F1.
